title: Seeing ahead through a state-of-the-art review of visual perception and predictive intelligence for collaborative robots
title_zh: 通过前沿综述视觉感知与预测智能，洞察协作机器人的未来
abstract: Abstract The rate at which collaborative robots (cobots) are evolving from isolated, pre-programmed manipulators into collaborative partners that operate productively alongside humans, other robots, and machines is accelerating rapidly. Advances in computer vision is enabling cobots, even in dynamic and cluttered settings, to detect, recognise and assess both environment and actions. However, achieving higher detection accuracy and real-time localization in dynamic systems remains a challenge, as most existing approaches assume uncluttered backgrounds with limited scene complexity. Closing this gap is critical for both research and industrial deployment. This paper reviews the development of visual perception in cobots, surveys emerging computer vision algorithms, and examines a holistic perception pipeline in which raw vision signals, vision language models (VLMs), and augmented/virtual reality interfaces jointly power a unified sense-think-act loop. The review finds that cobots in high-mix, reconfigurable factories face serious challenges: occlusions in fields of view, fluctuating illumination, ambiguous backgrounds, few- or zero-shot object scenarios, high-speed motion, and computational problems in fusing heterogeneous data streams in real time. Cobots also need to manipulate damaged items, requiring vision algorithms that infer geometry from sparse cues and support adaptive grasping. Finally, the review identifies three complementary research directions to unlock plug-and-play cobots: (1) information aware sensor-fusion pipelines transmitting only credible voxels to reduce bandwidth while preserving sub-millimetre accuracy; (2) language conditioned planning and control networks mapping plain-language goals to smooth, jerk-bounded trajectories; and (3) pre-trained few-shot reward heads that score task progress without bespoke metrics, closing the reinforcement learning (RL) loop. Combined, these advances promise cobots that can be commissioned with relatively few demonstrations.
abstract_zh: 摘要 随着协作机器人（cobots）从孤立的预编程操纵器迅速演变为能够与人类、其他机器人和机器高效协同工作的合作伙伴，其发展速度正加速。计算机视觉的进步使得协作机器人即使在动态且杂乱的环境中，也能检测、识别并评估环境与动作。然而，在动态系统中实现更高的检测精度和实时定位仍是挑战，因为大多数现有方法假设背景无杂乱且场景复杂度有限。弥补这一差距对科研和工业部署都至关重要。本文回顾了协作机器人视觉感知的发展，梳理了新兴的计算机视觉算法，并考察了一个整体感知管线，其中原始视觉信号、视觉语言模型（VLMs）和增强/虚拟现实界面共同驱动统一的感知-思考-执行循环。综述发现，高混合、可重构工厂中的协作机器人面临严峻挑战：视野遮挡、照明波动、背景模糊、少样本或零样本物体场景、高速运动，以及在实时融合异构数据流时的计算问题。协作机器人还需要处理受损物品，这要求视觉算法能够从稀疏线索推断几何并支持自适应抓取。最后，综述提出了三条互补的研究方向，以实现即插即用的协作机器人：（1）信息感知的传感器融合管线，仅传输可信体素以降低带宽同时保持亚毫米级精度；（2）基于语言的规划与控制网络，将普通语言目标映射为平滑、限加速度的轨迹；（3）预训练的少样本奖励头，无需专用指标即可评估任务进展，闭环强化学习（RL）。综合来看，这些进展有望实现仅需少量演示即可投入使用的协作机器人。
